title: Package portable command worker container artifact
description: Create a Plexus-owned, deployment-neutral container artifact for the portable command worker. Include a dedicated Dockerfile/entrypoint, deterministic dependency installation, a narrow runtime dependency set, and an immutable image interface suitable for the companion Fargate stack. Do not reuse the legacy EC2/SSM command-worker deployment or embed client paths, credentials, account settings, or dashboard stack internals. Add focused build/import tests and document the artifact contract.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented and opened PR #553: dedicated non-root Python 3.12 command-worker image, focused command-worker dependencies, package entrypoint validation, and package inclusion. Focused runtime/artifact tests passed (14).
